source: Edited directly in pull requests; validated by node scripts/work-packages.mjs validate (part of npm run check).

Former employee loses company authority; own identity persists.
Public projects expose no private attachments/prices/messages.
Object matrix and session/revocation tests pass.

Revoke between preflight and actual embedding dispatch denies new admission; expiry, wrong provider/model/policy/data class/query-vs-document permit, replay and pooled missing identity fail closed. Already admitted bytes are explicitly outside recall guarantee.

Human approval evidence separate from implementation checks.
Specify Russian retrieval source/citation/current/historical/partial/no-answer/revoked states from frozen contracts.

Buyer budget and seller floor private; shared terms exact.
Mixed supply/install/maintenance and optimistic concurrency tests pass.

Implement entitlement checks, price acceptance and atomic reservation/ledger port.
Support personal/company payers and project/employee scopes.

Concurrent reservations cannot exceed balance; no float money.
Free basic participation both sides; trial duration and journal policy remain unresolved.
No provider registration, payment or actual charge.

packages.title: Implement durable mandate and action workflow with fakes

steps: Define mandate/action digest and current-right recheck.
Persist operation/attempt identity before dispatch, outbox/reservations and fencing.

acceptance: Crash after external effect before result save leads to reconciliation by second worker, not blind replay.
Provider idempotency scope/retention documented; stale in-flight worker risk handled.
Acknowledged/pending is not final success; accepted-then-rejected outcome tested.
Unknown outcome retains reservations until definitive result; private constraints never leaked.
Only governed retrieval context; saved answers retain all source dependencies and current audience intersection; prompt text cannot alter mandates.

packages.title: Build commercial and assistant experiences

steps: Build intake/clarification/compare/version/acceptance flow with exact snapshots.
Show structured authority, budget, approvals and unknown/pending outcomes.
Share assistant conversation state between page and floating overlay.
Validate mixed workflows and narrow-screen tables with real APIs in approved local fixture environment.
acceptance: No docked reflowing panel or Agents navigation.
No unauthorized action from chat text; stop/revoke semantics honest.
Mobile/keyboard/empty/error/denial states verified; no approval claimed from screenshot.

Curate numbered/date issue with frozen content versions and archive.
Build responsive reader and separate PDF layout pipeline.
Validate correction/retraction, publication permissions and source licensing.
acceptance: News source/time labels; author vs editor rights distinct.
Magazine is curated issue; mobile readable and PDF inspected page-by-page.
No invented recurring journal paywall or public traction claims.

packages.title: Model project execution and fair reputation

steps: Preserve baseline/change attribution and plan dependency validation.
Record claims/evidence/confirmation/dispute/supersession independently.
Support goods delivery and works/services acceptance/defects.
Prototype dimension/sample methodology and appeal workflow with fixtures.
acceptance: Client-caused plan change cannot automatically penalize supplier.
Missing evidence not failure; subjective review distinct from fact.
Paying cannot improve reputation; private evidence not public by default.

packages.title: Verify standalone release candidate

Perform manual accessibility and browser journeys.
Restore synthetic data/objects with erasure replay and providers disabled.
Prove no required Contribuddha dependency; document release risks/providers/legal gates.
acceptance: Named nonempty exact-head CI and independent review.
Restore/permission/unknown-outcome tests demonstrated, not asserted.
Production provider/jurisdiction/RPO/RTO gates resolved before release authorization.

packages.title: Prepare first-class RAG architecture and deterministic contracts
packages.goal: Document the explicitly authorized RAG foundation without provisioning inference or claiming runtime quality.
steps: Reconcile earlier vector deferral with required hybrid retrieval.
Define source/field/party authority, citations, egress and derived-data lifecycle.
Add deterministic fake fixtures and future evidence gates; submit exact candidate.
acceptance: Architecture/source register/contracts/fixtures/DAG consistent; no source image changes.
Independent exact-head review and check required before integration; CI account blocker remains explicit.
One-off maintainer-authorized change before merge documented; integrator bookkeeping scope unchanged.

packages.title: Resolve corpus, model and retrieval evaluation contract
packages.goal: Specify rights-cleared gold corpus and model/config selection evidence before shared contracts freeze.
steps: Inventory actual permitted source shapes and expected load.
Compare pinned multilingual model candidates using authorized resources only.
Document benchmark protocol and immutable configuration proposal for FND-002.
acceptance: Corpus strata, rights, relevance labels, version/as-of and no-answer gold reviewed.
Model revisions/license/dimensions/limits/hardware/egress resolved or explicitly blocked; no fabricated real-model results.
Proposed quality/capacity thresholds reviewed; external vector store remains evidence-based.

packages.title: Implement permission-separated ingestion and index lifecycle
packages.goal: Build reproducible derived projections and pgvector generations under the accepted schema.
steps: After BE-001 acceptance, the assigned data integrator takes exclusive packages/data ownership for retrieval migrations and registration; preserve the accepted common admission primitive.
Implement outbox projection/extraction/embedding fakes, then only separately authorized adapters reusing BE-001 admission/revocation; never duplicate the gate or substitute a preflight check.
Test quarantine, duplicate events, taint, backfill, deletion and rollback; record exact build.
acceptance: No mixed-audience embedding; current purpose/egress rights before extraction/dispatch.
Idempotence, out-of-order changes, OCR/table locator quarantine, deletion/revocation and restore tombstone replay demonstrated.
Generation activation/rollback fenced by current policy/source watermark; model incompatibility rejected.

Embedding worker integration proves revoke between preflight and actual dispatch prevents new admission using the already accepted BE-001 gate; query/document and provider/model/data-class bindings are never interchangeable.

packages.title: Implement governed hybrid retrieval and delivery fencing
packages.goal: Deliver structured and semantic plans with current field/party rights and grounded citations.
steps: Implement typed runtime queries, structured resolver and hybrid fusion inside trusted boundary.

Reuse the accepted BE-001 common admission/revocation primitive for query embedding, reranking, answer dispatch and final response/citation delivery; implement current citation/dependency validation, not a second gate.
Exercise public-private taint, provider injection, no-answer, freshness and budget exhaustion.
acceptance: Private authorized exact subsets and public-only certified ANN; measured plans and filtered recall.
Candidates, hydration/provider egress and serialized final admission fail closed on revoke; multi-node race and pool reuse tested.
Saved answers inherit intersection of source rights; exact identifiers, RFQ versions and complete-domain calculations bypass top-k.

packages.title: Implement search, cited answers and freshness states
packages.goal: Expose understandable Russian search and citation experiences using frozen contracts.
steps: Prepare fixture-based layouts after FND-002 and DS-001; final implementation depends on RAG-301.
Integrate search and source drawer through owned components; request app-route integration from the frontend owner.
Test keyboard/mobile states, revoked citations and stale RFQ comparisons.
acceptance: Search/citations honor current access without hidden counts or unauthorized previews.
Partial/no-answer/unavailable/historical/stale states readable and accessible.
Citations open exact permitted versions; denied/revoked answer history handled without cached employer text.

packages.title: Verify real RAG quality, security, scale and recovery
packages.goal: Produce actual model/database/adversarial/restore evidence before standalone release QA.
steps: Run the evaluation protocol with pinned authorized model, DB and hardware.
Exercise adversarial boundary matrix and three 30-minute load runs per selected tier.
Record limitations, regressions, provider/cost policy and rollback drills for independent review.
acceptance: Frozen held-out Russian/multilingual/no-answer corpus, quality and citation metrics reported per stratum.
Zero authorization leakage across candidate/context/provider/delivery/citation/cache/history tested with revocation races.
Exact-vs-ANN recall, selective workloads, bounded fallback and transaction impact measured; restore/erasure/model rollback rehearsed.
No acceptance inferred from fake fixtures; unresolved target failures block QA.

packages.title: Platform administration research and screen contracts

steps: Study comparable products and admin frameworks.
Map capabilities, roles and separation of duties.
Write screen contracts, data/audit requirements and the implementation proposal.
acceptance: Separate staff surface; no implicit private access; no ranking controls; audited actions.

packages.title: Administration persistence

Create staff, case, moderation, claim, flag, config and incident tables.
acceptance: Runtime role cannot update or delete audit rows.
No columns added to other modules tables.

Facade use cases for MVP capabilities with fakes for unaccepted modules.
Real-PostgreSQL negative tests.

No endpoint accepts ranking weight.
No module imports platform-admin.

Core, editorial and commerce screen slices.

Browser tests with denied states.
acceptance: Permission and audit contracts honoured; no ranking or surveillance control.

Remove Russian integrations and plans from code and docs.

packages/country-packs test validates every pack; restricted codes cannot be enabled.
npm run check green at the candidate SHA.

The selector never lists a restricted place.
Screenshots of the selector and switcher.

No untranslated keys in uz-Latn.
Identifier and region facts cite their sources.

Terms section present in the template.

Quotas and capacity hold under concurrent registrations.

Sponsorship and payments never change listing order.

Implement certificate issuance, public check projection and revocation with reason.
Keep learning progress private to the learner; no employer view.

No certificate shows an accreditation without a recorded source.
Progress is never exposed to employers or other members.

packages.title: Implement capability profiles, needs board, explainable matching and introductions

Implement hard eligibility (region, licence, sanctions) with pass/fail/unknown results.
Implement versioned ranking with explanations and uncertainty; requester-tunable weights.

Add alerts for matching needs and invitations.
acceptance: Rankings are identical with and without paid entitlements (test).
Matching never reads private quotes, budgets or floors.
Contact details appear only after an introduction is accepted.
Unknown eligibility is shown as unknown, not as failure.

packages.title: Implement agent goals, agent-to-agent envelopes, negotiation sessions, company mandates and the company representative
packages.goal: Let a participant direct their single agent with goals, let a company keep one standing representative with an accountable person, and let agents of different participants negotiate safely through structured objects.
steps: Model goal, goal progress, agent envelope, negotiation session and company mandate.
Implement goal creation that proposes the missing mandate changes in one structured confirmation.
Implement envelope delivery with intents, digests of referenced versions, mandate digest and untrusted note handling.
Implement negotiation sessions with round limits, expiry and escalation to humans.

Implement the company representative: one per company, accountable person, company mandates with re-confirmation within 7 days after the granting member leaves, automatic suspension, labels on every action, company budgets only.
Implement company mandates that stop when the executor's authority ends.
Add hub-level and node-level kill switches for agent dispatch.
acceptance: No envelope note can change state; only structured intents after receiver mandate checks.
Private constraints never appear in envelopes, shared threads or logs visible to counterparties.
Agents of competing sellers never receive each other's pricing.
Revoking membership stops dependent company mandates in the same transaction.
There is still exactly one assistant surface per person and at most one representative per company; no agent management UI.
A company has at most one representative; it suspends when no accountable person or no confirmed mandate remains, and never exceeds the company's current grants.

packages.title: Implement hubs, territories, hub-scoped staff and versioned hub configuration
packages.goal: Make the hub a first-class object: territory, lifecycle, hub-scoped staff roles and configuration versions activated by a second person.

Scope staff role assignments and audit to a hub.
Implement second-person activation for sensitive configuration domains.
Implement the hub lifecycle with launch gates that block going public.
Refuse restricted territories at every entry point.
acceptance: A hub cannot go public with an open launch gate.
A restricted territory is rejected.
Sensitive configuration changes require a different approver.
No hub setting widens data access.

Implement legal documents with counsel approval records and activation.
Implement sources registry and import review queue.
Implement agents policy, communications, privacy and federation sections.
Localize every string in every hub language; axe and keyboard tests.
acceptance: Every private object returns not found to staff without a case grant, through every console path.
Activating a legal document without counsel approval fails.
No console control sets a score, position or badge directly.

Implement potential-match review cases and appeals decided by a different reviewer.
Map results to badge categories and eligibility flags used by claims and matching.
acceptance: Baseline sanctions screening cannot be disabled.
A potential match never auto-blocks or auto-clears.
Badges show categories, never documents.
Results expire and trigger re-checks per recipe.

packages.title: Country pack v2 facets with sourced facts for the launch countries
packages.goal: Extend packs with facets (registers, licensing, standards, procurement, tax and e-invoicing, e-signature, payments, calendar, scripts, privacy, content law, national sanctions lists), each sourced and honestly verified.

Extend the validator: sources required, rates as decimal strings, adapters referenced must exist.
Research and add facets for UZ, GE, AM and AZ starting with registers, tax and e-invoicing.
Update the country guide with facet instructions.
acceptance: Every fact has a source and a verification level.
No pack can enable a restricted place.
Engine code contains no country-specific branches.

packages.title: Specify the mesh protocol and federation contracts
packages.goal: Freeze the federation protocol of ADR 011 as contracts and conformance vectors before any implementation.
steps: Define manifest, global identifier, envelope, feed page, inbox delivery, tombstone, peering record and link proposal schemas.
Specify signature base and key rotation; publish test vectors.
Specify which projections each object kind may carry and enforce it in the schema.
Write the protocol specification document for implementers outside this repository.
acceptance: Envelopes with party_private or owner_private projections are rejected by schema.
Signature and digest vectors verify in tests.
Restricted jurisdictions are rejected at manifest validation.

packages.title: Implement node identity, manifest, signatures and peering records
packages.goal: Each node gets a signing key, a signed manifest, key rotation and peering agreements with levels.
steps: Generate and store the node key; serve the signed manifest at /.well-known/trustwork/manifest.json.
Implement request signing and verification.
Implement peering agreements with levels and second-person approval for deal-routing and identity.
Implement defederation.
acceptance: Unsigned or wrongly signed requests are rejected.
Peering above syndicate needs a second approver.
Defederation stops feeds and deliveries without rewriting history.

packages.title: Implement public syndication, replicas and tombstones
packages.goal: Public publications, issues, events and directory records flow between peered nodes as signed replicas with provenance, licences and tombstones.
steps: Implement cursor feeds per stream on the home node.
Implement pulling, verification and storage of read-only replicas.
Respect syndication flags from source licences.
Apply tombstones within the agreed period and purge indexes and caches.
acceptance: Replicas are read-only and never satisfy a write authorization.
Items with syndication none never leave their node.
Tombstones reach search indexes and caches.

packages.title: Implement directory federation and entity links
packages.goal: Companies and people known to several nodes are linked, never merged, with canonical display by claim strength and attributed verification badges.
steps: Implement link proposals from identifier matches and signed statements.
Implement data steward review on both nodes.
Display canonical records with field provenance.
Show peer verification badges only at trust-verifications level, labelled.
acceptance: No automatic merge.
A peer badge is always labelled with the granting node.
Reputation is never recomputed on a replica.

packages.title: Implement cross-node deals and agent envelopes
packages.goal: Participants on different nodes exchange introductions, RFQ invitations, quote versions and agreements with identical digests on both sides.
steps: Deliver shared_party envelopes to the counterparty's home node only.
Verify digests on both sides; bind acceptance to the same agreement digest.
Keep mandates, budgets and approvals on each party's own node.
Deliver agent envelopes with labels and rate limits per peering.
acceptance: Both nodes hold identical accepted terms proven by the same digest.
Nothing on one node can authorize an action on the other.
No delivery is routed through a third node.

packages.title: Implement federated sign-in between peered nodes
packages.goal: A person can register for an event or answer an RFQ on a peered node without a second account, at identity peering level.
steps: Implement nodes as OIDC providers and relying parties for each other.
Represent remote identities as (node, subject) pairs; never link by e-mail.
Limit what a remote identity may do to what the peering level allows.
acceptance: No auto-linking by e-mail.
A remote identity never gains local company authority.
Ending peering at identity level ends remote sessions.
